projectContext:
## Project structure
- Armature (package `armature`), a runtime for interfaces described as data — an Angular framework for JSON-driven dashboards with drag/drop, where boards, gadgets, and configuration forms are all composed at runtime. Formerly NGX Dynamic Dashboard Framework (ngx-dd-ui, plm-ui).
- src/app/gadgets/ — gadget components; gadget-registry.ts maps each componentType to a lazy `import()`, consumed by gadget-grid-cell-host.component.ts's signal-driven host (not a switch statement — each gadget type code-splits into its own chunk).
- src/app/gadgets/common/gadget-common/gadget-base/gadget.base.ts — abstract base class all gadgets extend.
- src/assets/api/library.json — gadget definitions and property schemas (add new gadgets here too).
- src/app/dynamic-form/ — dynamic property configuration form generation system.
- src/app/board/ — dashboard board management; boards/gadget instances persist to localStorage by default, no backend required.
- src/app/layout/ — layout and grid system.
- src/app/agent/ — agent panel + AgentService; calls a companion Spring Boot microservice (ngx-dynamic-dashboard-framework-microservice, environment.apihost) for chat and auth.
- Build: `ng build`. Test: `ng test` (Karma/Jasmine). Dev server: `ng serve` on http://localhost:4200/.
